item.title: Why India needs to rethink crypto taxation in Budget 2026
item.description: Global crypto markets are moving towards clearer and more balanced regulatory approaches. In India, this evolution offers an opportunity to review whether the current tax framework remains aligned with its original objectives.

item.title: Apple’s ‘terrific’ performance in India helps drive its best-ever quarter
item.description: Apple reported what CEO Tim Cook described as a “quarter for the record books,” driven by a “fantastic quarter for iPhone”. During this period, Apple clocked a top line of $143.8 billion and a bottom line of $42 billion.

item.title: Dell Technologies and NxtGen partner to build India’s largest AI factory
item.description: Dell AI Factory with NVIDIA will provide scalable, secure infrastructure for NxtGen’s AI platform, enabling national-scale AI development. The partnership will accelerate India’s AI mission and support large-scale generative, agentic, and physical AI while expanding NxtGen’s AI services nationwide.

item.title: Jaro Education posts strong Q3 FY26 growth, signals rising demand for new-age skills
item.description: The edtech firm reported a strong year-on-year growth in the third quarter of fiscal 2025, driven by rising demand among working professionals and enterprises for industry-aligned, outcome-led upskilling.
